what_it_is: A living blueprint of the client's digital location — product architecture, not a sitemap; derived from the project graph.
evolution: Exists from day one (planned nodes in outline) and fills in as families advance: F01 APPROVED · F02 APPROVED · F03 READY FOR YOU · F04 IN PRODUCTION · F05 UPCOMING.
nonlinear: Two layers: a JOURNEY SPINE (linear onboarding, e.g. ENTRY → SETUP → TODAY) and a HUB RING (nonlinear app families reachable from a hub, e.g. TODAY ↔ ACTIVITY, MONEY, PLAN…). Families are never forced into one line.

pattern: FOCUSED FAMILY VIEW (one family on screen)
NEXT / PREVIOUS connection chips at the bottom
hub families as a ring list under the hub node

tablet_desktop.pattern: Full plan: spine left-to-right, hub ring around its hub, families as grouped plots with their parent/children; edges drawn as calm architectural lines (solid = navigates, dashed = depends/unlocks).

interactions: select edge → what action connects them, is it live
no_editor_controls: No drag, connect, create, delete, layout editing, zoom-to-debug. The client views, understands, navigates and reviews.
tree_to_live: Node sheet → VIEW LIVE → /app/:slug/live/:nodeId opens that screen / family entry in the client viewport (scenario auto-selected).
live_to_tree: Live viewer → VIEW IN TREE → /app/:slug/project/tree?node=<current node> locates the screen inside the full architecture (highlighted, branch expanded).
approval_history: Per node (and in FINAL): approved families, current approved version, revision history — behind a HISTORY toggle, never in the primary view.
post_launch: Stays in the client project archive (LIBRARY → FINAL FILES link + PROJECT) as the human-readable map of what was built — for EVOLVE work, maintenance, new families, extensions, handoff.
